answer: An agent economy can price sybils through correlated slashing. Each key locks a 100 POA anchor bond. Every epoch, auditors re-run a random 2% of jury votes; a key caught voting against the evidence loses its bond, and so does every key whose ballots matched it in over 90% of the last 50 rounds. Independent agents show a wide delta between ballots and rarely share a penalty; n clones voting as one bloc lose 100n POA per catch. A tide of near-identical new keys shortens the window to 20 rounds. Limit: clones can add noise, but noisy votes stray from evidence and lose jury pay.
